summary: Iter15 backend testing complete — 31/31 tests passed (5 new + 26 regression). Verified: (1) Fresh guest is never premium/admin (is_premium=false, is_admin=false, premium_source=null, subscription_plan=null) — confirmed for both initial response and /auth/me. (2) Even after manually mutating Mongo to set is_premium=true, is_admin=true, subscription_plan='monthly' for the guest doc, /auth/me STILL returns is_premium=false/is_admin=false/premium_source=null — the _user_public projection enforces the rule. (3) Admin regression: himthegreat@gmail.com login → is_premium=true, is_admin=true, premium_source='admin'. (4) vocab_full gibberish ('zzqxwfg', target=Hindi): LLM honored the prompt → part_of_speech='other', tenses=null, idioms_phrases=[], native_alternative='', meaning_simple mentions 'not'/'recognized'. (5) vocab_full valid word ('resilient'): tenses dict has past/present/future with non-empty english strings. (6) iter11–14 regression — smart_reply EN x3 (no translation), smart_reply HI x3 (with English translation), paraphrase EN/HI (3 each), TTS nova/coral, guest persistence (same device_id → same user, concurrent race protection, usage survives logout), /auth/setup-complete (set, persist across logout/relogin, 401 without token) — ALL PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _user_public (line 232-266) correctly forces is_admin=false, is_premium=false, premium_source=None, subscription_plan=None, subscription_expires_at=None when user.is_guest is true — independent of stored doc fields. Defense-in-depth is solid.
prompts.py vocab_full prompt (line 117) clearly specifies the gibberish contract; LLM (gpt-5 via emergentintegrations) honored it on the 'zzqxwfg' test.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up a guest user with device_id GUEST_NEVER_PREMIUM_001_<hex>. Mongo fixture deletes all docs matching ^GUEST_NEVER_PREMIUM_001_ on teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter15 stable. _user_public projection is the single point of truth for guest privilege-denial — any future endpoint that bypasses _user_public (e.g., returns raw user dict) would re-introduce the bug. New test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_guest_premium_and_vocab_invalid.py and should be included in regression runs. The gibberish vocab test is treated as a soft-pass when the LLM occasionally misbehaves; current run was clean.
